content.text:
I fixed the contact page by changing `.form-field` in `site/css/components.css:226` from `margin-bottom: 0` to `margin-bottom: var(--space-4)`. That setting had the form fields (name, email, topic, message, consent) stacked with no gap, and the Send button flush against the last one.

I didn't render the page to look at it. I found the cause by reading the CSS, so please check it in the browser. The 16 functional tests pass, but they don't test spacing.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what "the last change" was. If something else looks wrong on the page, tell me what and I'll look again.

STATUS: DONE
